experiences.position: Customer Reference Program Coordinator, Sales Operations
experiences.description:
Job Description:
The NetSuite Sales Reference Program Coordinator assists the sales representatives in finding and securing reference customers for prospects and helps manage the customer database in NSCorp.

Responsibilities:
•	Replies to Sales Reference Requests sent by the Sales Team or Account Management Organization
•	Constantly updates the customer NSCorp records: reference events, tags appropriate descriptors, go-live details and additional important account details
•	Forwards customer requests to the appropriate internal teams
•	Helps sales reps with presentations by providing customer logos, quotes, etc.
•	Identifies key accounts and recruits them to be a part of the program
•	Nominates customers to be interviewed for success stories
•	Works with Marketing, PR and Reference team to insure the overall happiness of reference customers
•	Acts as a key liaison between internal contacts and key reference accounts.

•	Responsible for developing and maintaining post-sales relationships with named customer accounts critical to the company in terms of recurring base revenue and future growth.
•	Manages, services and up-sells to customer key accounts
•	Operates under minimal supervision with latitude for independent judgment
•	Reports directly to the Manager of Customer Management
•	Performs Sales activities for assigned strategic accounts to achieve or exceed assigned revenue objectives
•	Up sells products/services over the phone
•	Remains knowledgeable of the company’s products/services to facilitate sales efforts
•	Maintains sales records and prepares sales reports as required
•	Maintains regular contact with customers to ensure as required

experiences.position: Customer Service Representative, Optus Local Access Direct
experiences.description:
•	Provides excellent and quality customer satisfaction and problem resolution to customers who call in with regard to their home phone service. 
•	Handles and resolves customers' billing and general issues, needs and concerns. 
•	Acts as the Team Lead assistant, support and POC (Point of Contact) whenever the Immediate Supervisor is not around or whenever needed. 
•	As Team POC, generates and submits daily/weekly/monthly reports and data regarding the team and the team members’ production performance. 
•	Answers escalated or supervisory calls from specialists. 
•	Acts as Service Level POC by walking the floor to answer agents' queries and flagging and assisting agents with long talk time/after call work/hold time.
•	Does agents interactions by means of conducting team meetings, one on one coaching, side by side call listening, and remote call monitoring.
•	Plots agents' schedules and scrubs agents' time punches using the company's time record keeping system.
